item.title: Takeaways from Seattle Seahawks 41-6 rout of 49ers in NFC divisional round
item.description: The Seattle Seahawks delivered an emphatic statement by easily dispatching a short-handed San Francisco 49ers in a 41-6 romp on Saturday night to reach their fourth NFC championship game in franchise history.

item.title: Rashid Shaheed's touchdown causes seismic spike in Seattle, Seahawks NFC championship bound
item.description: Seismologists say Seattle fans were so excited by an early game touchdown that the tens of thousands of cheering spectators actually caused a rumble in the area that fans are now calling the “Rashidquake."
